subject.title: fix: deliver background task completions through owning sessions

question: Should this PR wait for live Telegram owner-session delivery proof before merge, or may maintainers intentionally accept source and CI proof only for this session-routing change?
rationale: The code path is a user-visible Telegram/session delivery fix, and the PR body and checks do not yet provide an observed real transport run showing the changed delivery behavior.

options.title: Require live Telegram delivery proof
options.body: Wait for a redacted Telegram Desktop recording, gateway logs, terminal/live output, or linked artifact showing the completion reaches the owning topic/session with heartbeat isolation enabled.

options.title: Accept source-only delivery risk
options.body: Merge with source, regression-test, and CI evidence only, while explicitly owning the risk that real transport/session delivery may still misroute or drop completion messages.

options.title: Pause for broader delivery contract
options.body: Hold this PR if maintainers want one canonical task-completion wake contract across background-task, ACP, exec, and subagent paths before landing another targeted exception.

recommendation.title: Require live Telegram delivery proof
recommendation.body: Wait for a redacted Telegram Desktop recording, gateway logs, terminal/live output, or linked artifact showing the completion reaches the owning topic/session with heartbeat isolation enabled.

likelyOwner.reason: Recent task and subagent completion delivery history makes this the strongest routing candidate for proof and session/message delivery judgment.
